description: This Java class 'NotificationWritePlatformServiceImpl' implements notification writing logic for the Fineract platform, handling creation of notifications and mapping them to users.

classes.name: NotificationWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of NotificationWritePlatformService for creating and mapping notifications.

methods.name: insertIntoNotificationGenerator
methods.description: Creates a new Notification object, populates it with given details, and persists it, returning its ID.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Creates a notification and maps it to a collection of user IDs, returning the generated notification ID.

methods.name: insertIntoNotificationMapper
methods.description: Maps a notification to multiple users by creating NotificationMapper entries for each user.
